notes: Added auditability, persistence, and edge-case handling stories to close HIPAA compliance gaps.

stories.title: Consent Audit Logging
stories.description: Implement audit logging for all consent-related actions including grant, update, and revocation. Logs must capture timestamp, consent tier, action type, and anonymized session/user reference to support HIPAA audit requirements.

stories.title: Consent Persistence and Retrieval
stories.description: Implement storage and retrieval of consent state in MongoDB, ensuring consent tier is consistently available across session interactions and downstream services.

stories.title: Consent Revocation and Downgrade Handling
stories.description: Implement logic to handle user revocation or downgrade from Tier 2 to Tier 1 consent, including enforcement of de-identification for future data and prevention of further identified storage.
